call.x: The Opportunity The Smart and Resilient Energy Systems Call for Proposals aims to develop operational solutions using space-enabled technologies to improve the anticipatory, operational, and strategic resilience of electricity grids. Solutions should have a strong focus on critical infrastructure protection, climate resilience, and emergency preparedness. The Call has been developed in collaboration with ELES, Slovenia's combined transmission and distribution system operator, and is based on operational requirements and challenges identified by the organisation. These requirements reflect real-world needs associated with forecasting and grid operations, dynamic thermal rating enhancement,...

HE-GA-B.title: Horizon Europe Work Programme 2026-2027, General Annexes, B - Eligibility

consortium.quote: Unless otherwise provided for in the specific call/topic conditions, only legal entities forming a consortium are eligible to participate in actions provided that the consortium includes, as beneficiaries, three legal entities independent from each other and each established in a different country as follows: – at least one independent legal entity established in a Member State; and – at least two other independent legal entities, each established in different Member States or Associated Countries.
